Three layers (lexical / framing / geometric) are simultaneously broken.

## Reproducer recipe

leading BOM bytes; valid header; one surface with v-knots `(0,0,0,0.4,0.3,1,1,1)`; no closing `END-ISO-10303-21;`.

## Expected kernel behavior

each invariant addressed independently — encoding policy on BOM, framing-token policy, knot-vector validity. A kernel that fails fast on BOM never gets to the knot defect; one that accepts BOM must then face it.
